title: Projected lattice cells of ℝ^{N+1}: vertical cells contribute 0, horizontal cells are isometric copies of grid cubes of ℝ^N (parent steps 5(c) and 9)
statement: Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d] (Mathlib's normalized Euclidean Hausdorff measure). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω), d = exteriorDerivative); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm: |α|² = Σ_I α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(d−1)})² over strictly increasing I); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 denotes the standard basis vector of the respective space; castSucc : Fin P → Fin (P + 1) and last = Fin.last P. Let N ∈ ℕ, ρ ∈ ℝ, let p : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^N be a continuous linear map with (py)_i = y_{castSucc i} for all y and i ∈ Fin N, let z ∈ ℤ^{N+1} and let ι : Fin N → Fin (N + 1) be strictly increasing. Put F̃ := {y ∈ ℝ^{N+1} : for every i, ρz_i ≤ y_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1) if i ∈ range ι, and y_i = ρz_i if i ∉ range ι} (the cell of the cubical grid of side ρ at z spanned by the directions ι) and G := {x ∈ ℝ^N : ρz_{castSucc i} ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_{castSucc i} + 1) for every i ∈ Fin N}. (a) If last = Fin.last N ∈ range ι ('vertical' cell), then ∫_{F̃} ω(py)(pe_{ι(0)}, …, pe_{ι(N−1)}) dHᴺ(y) = 0 for every N-form ω on ℝ^N (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) N). (b) If last ∉ range ι ('horizontal' cell), then ∫_{F̃} ω(py)(pe_{ι(0)}, …, pe_{ι(N−1)}) dHᴺ(y) = ∫_G ω(x)(e_0, …, e_{N−1}) dHᴺ(x) for every N-form ω on ℝ^N, and every x ∈ G equals py for some y ∈ F̃. (All integrals are Bochner integrals; no integrability is assumed.)
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (p : Euclid (N + 1) →L[ℝ] Euclid N) (z : Fin (N + 1) → ℤ) (ι : Fin N → Fin (N + 1)), (∀ (y : Euclid (N + 1)) (i : Fin N), p y i = y (Fin.castSucc i)) → StrictMono ι → (Fin.last N ∈ Set.range ι → ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) N, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), (i ∈ Set.range ι → ρ * z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ ρ * (z i + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range ι → y i = ρ * z i)}, ω (p y) (fun k => p (EuclideanSpace.single (ι k) (1 : ℝ))) ∂μHE[N] = 0) ∧ (Fin.last N ∉ Set.range ι → (∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) N, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), (i ∈ Set.range ι → ρ * z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ ρ * (z i + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range ι → y i = ρ * z i)}, ω (p y) (fun k => p (EuclideanSpace.single (ι k) (1 : ℝ))) ∂μHE[N] = ∫ x in {x : Euclid N | ∀ i : Fin N, ρ * z (Fin.castSucc i) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ ρ * (z (Fin.castSucc i) + 1)}, ω x (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) ∂μHE[N]) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid N, (∀ i : Fin N, ρ * z (Fin.castSucc i) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ ρ * (z (Fin.castSucc i) + 1)) → ∃ y : Euclid (N + 1), (∀ i : Fin (N + 1), (i ∈ Set.range ι → ρ * z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ ρ * (z i + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range ι → y i = ρ * z i)) ∧ p y = x)
